candidate.name: LS-05 integration slice on integrated main
candidate.description: First native validation of the merged main (PR24 live Armory + PR25 refresh/selected + LS-03/04/06/07/08/09/10 source slices). Candidate = previous live Armory candidate a1b8933 plus the refresh-selected title marker and mid-cycle wallet/price refresh.

preparation_and_compilation.authoring_note: prepare_progression.py ran on Shatner with the Onyx qa-ls05-dynamic input vintage (private-inputs and native-tags baseline copied over) to keep candidate continuity with a1b8933.

compile.tool: Sapien (sapien.exe) Ctrl+Shift+C + Ctrl+S in isolated kit qa-ls01/clean-kit
compile.sapien_state: Ready status, no error dialogs, output window clean

cache.tool: tool.exe build-cache-file levels\survivors\last_stand\last_stand pc none english

boot.menu_open_at_stage_entry: true by design (sv_enter_stage opens the Armory)

armory_render.selection_marker: visible: '> Needler Power | +4DMG/rank | Cost1/1/2 | Req Unlock1 S1' (merged PR25 marker renders in the CHUD objective)
armory_render.tree: Unlock1* / Power0+ Rate0+ / Seeker0- Crystal0- / Long Reach0- Crystal Storm0-

resume.method: '1' key (rotate_weapons) with console closed and a clean gap after console typing
resume.result: menu closed (sv_menu_open false), clock advanced (sv_seconds > 0, sv_stage_seconds > 0)
resume.note: Console keystrokes leak into the game action system: typed text containing spaces/digits fires jump/rotate_weapons actions and eats the input latch. QA harness pitfall, not a candidate defect. Leave a gap between console typing and game-input keys.

gameplay.result: combat ran, stationary player died naturally, run ended (sv_finished true, game speed 0.0 stopped arena)

continue.result: checkpoint restored: sv_running true, stage 1, menu closed

production_preservation.stop_method: SIGTERM to launcher (clean shutdown, watcher archived final cores)
production_preservation.profile_verification: all 26 pre-existing files byte-identical to backup; 2 normal session files added
production_preservation.production_state_at_release: running, paused in Armory (original v0.4 game)

limitations: Bounded SDK checks only; no full 20-minute ordinary run, no balance data, no retail MCC validation, no package promotion.
The merged mid-cycle wallet/price refresh (PR25) compiles and the wallet renders, but the 15-tick midpoint refresh was not isolated and measured natively.
Console assertion infrastructure (LS-03) worked end to end: every observation is bound to the staged candidate fingerprint via native_qa.
Not a release promotion; the installed v0.4 package and launcher are unchanged.
